title: Meta's Muse App Now Lets Users Create Personalized 'Spaces' via Prompts

tickers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Meta has introduced a feature that lets users build their own tailored in-app environments within its Muse app by providing text prompts to the AI. These custom "Spaces" are designed to automatically keep track of a user's specific interests and can be pinned to the application's navigation bar for immediate access and continuous updates.

The update accompanies a broader deployment of specialized models based on the Muse Wonder architecture for both Muse and Meta AI. These models incorporate "Active Memory" and "Active Focus" to prevent the AI from forgetting goals during complex tasks, which Meta says improves task completion by 67% in Muse. Third-party benchmarks reported an accompanying 9% increase in the Personal Superintelligence Index and a 14% rise in the Active Memory Eval.

selectedTweets.text:
Today we're bringing specialized models trained using Muse Wonder to @Muse and Meta AI, giving users access to some of Muse Wonder's frontier capabilities for complex tasks at work and in everyday life.

These specialized models include Muse Wonder's Active Memory and Active Focus, helping them stay aligned with your goals as tasks unfold:

→ Active Memory helps recognize when earlier information matters and distinguish what's still relevant from what's become stale

→ Active Focus helps recover from setbacks or find alternatives when constraints change

In Muse, the improved models show a 2.4x reduction in forgetting information critical to your goals and a 67% improvement in getting unstuck as constraints evolve. That means less repeating yourself and fewer dead ends when plans change.

In Meta AI, these improvements help it break complex problems into steps, ask sharper follow-up questions and adapt when you change direction.

Read more on our research blog: https://t.co/ACWFr9xPtS
